attestations.text: CHIANG Hsiang 姜瓖 d. Oct. 4, 1649, a native of Yü-lin, Shensi, was stationed in 1644 as a brigade-general of the Ming army at Hsüan-hua, in northern Chihli, when the rebel leader Li Tzŭ-ch'êng [q. v.] attacked that city on his march to the capital.
